points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B with adversarial testing methodologies, identifying jailbreak vulnerabilities and improving model robustness by ~20% through systematic red-teaming approaches.

\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings with BM25 search for AI security testing, enhancing detection of prompt injection attacks and misuse cases across multiple LLM systems.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess AI vulnerabilities, faithfulness, and exploit discovery across hundreds of adversarial test cases, ensuring production-ready reliability through structured red-teaming taxonomies.

\item Optimized vulnerability testing workflows through batched adversarial query generation, reducing testing time by ~80% while systematically pushing AI systems to their breaking points with reproducible attack artifacts.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for AI security posture monitoring, reducing false negatives by 25% and identifying high-impact socio-technical vulnerabilities that automated testing systems fail to detect.

\item Implemented a tool-using LLM agent (LangGraph/ReAct) with structured testing playbooks for systematic evaluation of AI model security, generating detailed reports and datasets for vulnerability classification and risk analysis.
